teacherHint: Click Enter to open the BODA app. If this is your first visit, you'll be guided through installation.
teacherJoined: Your teacher has entered the classroom.
waitingHint: The Enter button becomes active once your teacher opens the classroom (auto-refresh every 10 seconds).

roomEnded.default: This classroom is not available for entry.

unknown.title: Could not enter the classroom
unknown.body: Please retry shortly or contact your administrator.

BODA_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_WINDOW.title: Not within the entry window
BODA_LAUNCH_OUT_OF_WINDOW.body: You can enter from 10 minutes before the start to 15 minutes after the end.

BODA_NOT_BODASCHOOL.title: Not a BODA School classroom
BODA_NOT_BODASCHOOL.body: This event uses a different video system. Check the meeting URL in the calendar.

BODA_ROOM_NOT_PROVISIONED.title: Classroom not yet provisioned
BODA_ROOM_NOT_PROVISIONED.body: Ask an admin to re-save the event and the classroom will be re-created automatically.

NOT_AN_ATTENDEE.title: You are not authorized for this classroom
NOT_AN_ATTENDEE.body: Only invited students and the assigned teacher can join.

EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
EVENT_NOT_FOUND.body: The event was deleted or the link is invalid.

BODA-NOT_INSTALLED.title: BODA School app is not installed
BODA-NOT_INSTALLED.body: Visit the installation guide and try again.

BODA-NOT_CONNECTED_AGENT.title: Not connected to the BODA app
BODA-NOT_CONNECTED_AGENT.body: Confirm the app is running and retry.
